Name: Microsoft Mahjong
Description: Mahjong solitaire: clear the layout by matching free pairs of tiles until none are left.

Achievements.Name: The Fun Begins
Achievements.Description: Complete your first puzzle on your phone.

Achievements.Name: Mahjong Pro
Achievements.Description: Complete your first hard puzzle on your phone.

Achievements.Name: A Fresh Coat of Paint
Achievements.Description: Try out a different theme on your phone.

Achievements.Name: Force of Habit
Achievements.Description: Complete the same puzzle 20 times.

Achievements.Name: Speed Player
Achievements.Description: Complete an expert puzzle in five minutes or less.

Achievements.Name: High Five
Achievements.Description: Win 10 games of Mahjong in a row.

Achievements.Name: On Second Thought...
Achievements.Description: After reaching "No More Moves", undo at least 10 moves in a row and then complete the puzzle.

Achievements.Name: Ultimate Matchmaker
Achievements.Description: Match 3 sets of wild tiles in a row.

Achievements.Name: Dragon Master
Achievements.Description: Complete the Dragon puzzle 15 times.

Achievements.Name: Warmed Up
Achievements.Description: Complete four different puzzles in the easy category.

Achievements.Name: On A Roll
Achievements.Description: Complete four different puzzles in the medium category.

Achievements.Name: Mahjong Champion
Achievements.Description: Complete four different puzzles in the hard category.

Achievements.Name: Smooth Sailing
Achievements.Description: Complete any puzzle without using Undo.

Achievements.Name: Finished Already?!
Achievements.Description: Complete any puzzle in 2 minutes or less.

Achievements.Name: Gaining Recognition
Achievements.Description: Earn 10 Medals total across a Windows 8 device and your phone.

Achievements.Name: Matchmaking Legend
Achievements.Description: Earn 20 Medals total across a Windows 8 device and your phone.

Achievements.Name: Take it to Go
Achievements.Description: Play 1,000 Mahjong Games or Begin a game on a Windows 8 device and finish it on your phone.

Achievements.Name: Winning is a Habit
Achievements.Description: Complete 100 puzzles.

Achievements.Name: Highlighter
Achievements.Description: Complete a puzzle on your phone with the "Show available tiles" option turned on.

Achievements.Name: The Spice Of Life
Achievements.Description: Match 20 pairs of tiles in a row where all 20 pairs are unique.
